examples.text: Здесь всегда продукты самого высокого качества.
examples.trans: There are always products of the highest quality here.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to him', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: У нас работает команда профессиональных поваров.
examples.trans: A team of professional chefs works here.

examples.text: Мы всё прекрасно понимаем.
examples.trans: We understand everything perfectly.

examples.text: Конечно, нашему ресторану нужен хороший хозяин.
examples.trans: Of course, our restaurant needs a good owner.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ветить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'answered', paired with 'отвечать'.

examples.text: А что ему ответил наш Нагиев?
examples.trans: And what did our Nagiyev answer him?

examples.text: Я должен ответить.
examples.trans: I have to answer.

examples.text: Ответь мне!
examples.trans: Answer me!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'our', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Наш ресторан всегда остаётся лучшим в Москве.
examples.trans: Our restaurant always remains the best in Moscow.

examples.text: Конечно, нашему ресторану нужен хороший хозяин.
examples.trans: Of course, our restaurant needs a good owner.

examples.text: Там была каждая наша копейка.
examples.trans: Every single kopeck of ours was there.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Ну, я просто так подумала.
examples.trans: Well, I just thought so.

examples.text: Он просто послал меня обратно работать.
examples.trans: He just sent me back to work.

examples.text: Шеф просто дал мне срочную работу.
examples.trans: Chef just gave me urgent work.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'слать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'sent'.

examples.text: Он просто послал меня обратно работать.
examples.trans: He just sent me back to work.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и послать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and sent on time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ратно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Он просто послал меня обратно работать.
examples.trans: He just sent me back to work.

examples.text: Если честно разобраться, я ведь тоже банкрот.
examples.trans: If we look at it honestly, I am bankrupt too.

examples.text: Потом обратно бесплатно отвезу.
examples.trans: Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: У нас работает команда профессиональных поваров.
examples.trans: A team of professional chefs works here.

examples.text: Иди скорее поработай в зале.
examples.trans: Go and do some work in the dining room.

examples.text: Он просто послал меня обратно работать.
examples.trans: He just sent me back to work.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'wants', paired with 'захотеть'.

examples.text: Шеф, простите нас, я правда не хотел.
examples.trans: Chef, forgive us, I really did not mean to.

examples.text: Прости меня, Дима, я хотел уйти красиво.
examples.trans: Forgive me, Dima, I wanted to leave in style.

examples.text: Я хочу кофе.
examples.trans: I want coffee.
